status: design — NOT frozen, NOT launched. Prefix sizes and realized node totals are materialized by the freeze step before any training starts and before any target value is read.
question: At a fixed teacher/search node budget, does supervision density (many rows x shallow labels) beat a few deep labels, measured on a common frozen instrument — and where does the curve turn?
framing: Gen10 repeatedly purchased expensive oracle values over a relatively narrow set of distinct positions (7.44 s of Stockfish per unique position, 13.8 purchases each). The lab hypothesis under test: purchase broad cheap search coverage, attach deterministic structure everywhere, and selectively increase supervision quality only where evidence says it pays.
scope: RAW-768 only; uniform selection over one frozen order; one teacher (CVS analyze); one pool; replication is issue #16
reference_budget_source: S6 UNIFORM arm realized deep nodes (labstore/objects/datasets/D0009.json campaign.deep_nodes)

pool.openings: built-in OPENING_LINES (12 lines, disjoint from the instrument's held-out 10); openingSourceSha256 expected sha256:588f36887eaa3b04fbf2fb65ae022e1a02e33bc05ac867f97e9713c3eefdb5ed
pool.games: batches of 400 up to hard cap 2400; stop when unique records >= 12000
pool.unique_yield_estimate: 13.4/game at 70 games (measured, S5); expect 30-40% of raw rows at this size

leakage_control.join_target: the FULL evaluation-source population N0010 (S0009 -> N0010): all 575 records, NOT only the 200 selected by D0010
leakage_control.why: an unselected evaluation-source record can be the transitive bridge between a training position and a selected instrument record; a join that ignores it proves the wrong thing
rule: build joint transposition components of new pool U all 575 N0010 records: shared EPD record_id -> union of the two groups; recompute roots (same union rule as tools/s6/s6_round3.py lines 119-155, which unions over all evaluation records and only then filters the selection)
instrument_components = joint roots of the 200 D0010 records

required invariant: instrument_adjacent_with_200 == 0; if violated, remove the offending pool records from the candidate universe; if the 200 cannot be made disconnected (a kept pool record shares a joint component with one of the 200) -> STOP

conservative exclusion applied at the same time: also remove pool records whose joint root contains ANY of the 575 evaluation-source records (the 575 is the instrument's reusable source population for future studies such as S8); report removed_vs_575_population
if the conservative removal exceeds 5% of the pool -> STOP and build a fresh instrument before any training
removal rule is deterministic and never inspects a label value; the candidate universe is then frozen and hashed
leakage_control.expected: zero collisions (the 575 clean records were proven disjoint from all 12 components of the S5 pool with a union taken over all 575, and the instrument was built from a disjoint opening partition)
leakage_control.pilot_inherits: yes — round3's clean set was computed over all 575 records, so the pilot needs no new leakage work

calibration.selection: deterministic hash order over the frozen candidate universe, seed 20260916
calibration.forbidden: reading scoreCpStm (or any target value) before the arms are constructed, and before any training
calibration.sanity_band: every mean_b in [0.90*b, b]; outside -> STOP
calibration.role: prediction only; the expected sizes n_b ~= round(T / mean_b) are reported but have no authority over arm construction

order.rule: order = sort(candidate_universe, key=sha256(f'{seed}:{record_id}')) with seed 20260916; frozen once

budget_fill.role: CONSTRUCTION — this defines the arm sizes; it replaces any post-hoc admissibility test
budget_fill.procedure: for each arm, walk the frozen order from index 0 and buy labels at that arm's budget, accumulating realized nodes C_k; include record k+1 iff |C_(k+1) - T| <= |C_k - T|, else stop and exclude it
inputs: realized node counts from the pinned engine
forbidden_inputs: any test_loss, metric or evaluation result
budget_fill.probe_label: the label whose purchase triggered the stop decision is paid for, recorded as a paid label, and excluded from the arm
budget_fill.parity_bound: by construction the prefix is the closest to T among all prefixes, so parity error <= half a label: <=0.54% of T for A1 and tighter for A2-A4
budget_fill.materialization: realized prefix sizes, realized node totals and the sealed record list are written into this file and a copy of the preregistration before any training and before any target value is read

nesting.reason: closest-prefix filling is deterministic, but n_A1 <= n_A2 <= n_A3 <= n_A4 depends on realized node use being monotone in the budget per record — an empirical property of the engine's termination rules, not a theorem of the procedure
nesting.hard_rule: the freeze step asserts the prefix relation A1 subset A2 subset A3 subset A4; violation -> STOP
nesting.diagnostic: because the arms are nested, every record in A1 carries labels at all four budgets; per-record node monotonicity and label movement are measured on the shared prefix and reported alongside the frozen prefixes
nesting.authority: the freeze-time assertion guards the construction; the diagnostic is reported, not decisive

capacity_decision: keep the S6 ladder unchanged: the treatment is supervision, capacity must be held fixed, and changing the ladder after seeing S6's own outcomes would be selecting on that experiment's noise
recipe_note: identical across arms except TARGET_SPEC; fixed epochs means wider arms receive more optimizer steps — declared asymmetry, a breadth loss is the stronger inference
initialization: cold-start (no legacy warm start), seed-derived per run

instrument.reuse: E0004 + D0010 unchanged iff leakage_control passes
instrument.invariant: all runs in the experiment pin the same evaluation protocol hash and the same evaluation TargetSpec hash; each arm pins its own training TargetSpec; train_spec == eval_spec is NOT required and NOT expected

analysis.method: Student t, df=4, t=2.776 (same helper as S6: paired_effect)
analysis.primary_contrast: d_H = mean over seeds of [test_loss(A4,H,seed) - test_loss(A1,H,seed)]

decision_rule.BREADTH_WINS: every width's primary-contrast CI upper bound < 0
decision_rule.DEPTH_WINS: every width's primary-contrast CI lower bound > 0

adjacent_contrasts.role: preregistered secondary; reported for every width whether or not the primary contrast is decisive
adjacent_contrasts.why: the result we want is where the curve turns (e.g. a 64k sweet spot with 16k degrading = A3-A2 < 0 and A4-A3 > 0), which the endpoint contrast alone would miss

efficient_regime.role: descriptive and preregistered; selects S8's budget, decides no hypothesis
efficient_regime.rule: per width, the arm with the lowest mean test_loss; ties broken toward the shallower budget; report the set of widths agreeing on the same arm

other_secondary: monotonicity of the four arm means per width
width x density interaction blocked by seed
analysis.required_reporting: all cell means, all per-seed differences, CIs for the primary and all three adjacent contrasts, realized node totals per arm, full identity table; failed cells reported INVALID, never omitted
analysis.scope_statement: this pool, this teacher, these four budgets, RAW-768
analysis.design_summary: same frozen position order; roughly equal teacher-node spend per arm; four label depths; RAW-768 only; H1/H4/H16/H32 unchanged; five paired seeds; one common 400k evaluation instrument; A4-A1 is the primary breadth-vs-depth question; adjacent contrasts expose where the curve turns

fail_closed: engine leakage: any pool record instrument-adjacent to the 200 D0010 records that cannot be removed, or conservative removal against the 575-record N0010 source above 5% of the pool -> STOP (fresh instrument)
engine identity drift (analyze sha256 or net hashes differ from pins) -> STOP
determinism gate: re-label 8 stored positions (4 at 16k, 4 at 400k) and require exact scoreCpStm reproduction -> STOP on mismatch
unique pool records < 4 * n_A4, or 2400-game cap reached -> STOP
calibration mean outside [0.90*b, b] for any budget -> STOP
fill parity check: the closest prefix found by the construction must land within +/-2% of T (bounded by half a label, so this checks the construction, not the arms) -> STOP if outside
nesting violated (A1 subset A2 subset A3 subset A4 as prefixes) -> STOP
zero or multiple matching labels for any row under its spec -> freeze/training raises (existing behaviour)
any run with a protocol_hash or eval_dataset_manifest_hash different from the experiment instrument -> INVALID
no tuning after the first arm label is bought (budgets, prefixes, seed, widths, epochs, LR, batch, init)
no target-value peeking before arm construction; no training before the instrument identity is frozen and the filled prefixes are sealed
silent train/eval TargetSpec divergence remains a hard failure (see P1)

prerequisites.title: minimal train/eval TargetSpec separation (first-class capability, not an S7 hack)
prerequisites.current_behaviour: hard failure when recipe T spec hash != protocol E spec hash
required_behaviour: divergence is still a hard failure by default
permitted only through an explicit declaration made at ablation-creation time, part of the ablation identity hash and copied into every run record, so it cannot be added after the fact
when declared, both spec hashes (train, eval) are recorded as visible integrity checks on the run
the invariant enforced is: one experiment shares one evaluation protocol and one evaluation TargetSpec, while each treatment arm pins its own training TargetSpec
tests: declared divergence runs to completion and records both spec hashes
a row with zero or two matching labels under either spec still fails
two runs declaring different evaluation specs cannot be compared (refused at the comparison layer)
prerequisites.why: S7 arms are trained at their own budget and evaluated on the common 400k instrument; the S6 check was written when both were 400k

prerequisites.title: experiment identity X#### — one object above the ablations
prerequisites.rationale: A#### already means exactly one ablation with possibly several R#### runs; an S7 study spans 16 ablations, so it needs an object above them

binds.instrument: eval_dataset_id + manifest hash, eval_protocol_id + protocol hash, eval_spec_hash

each run's train spec equals its arm's declared spec

verified at queue time and again at analysis time, failing closed

identities_expected.N: canonical normalization (EPD identity, components, duplicates reported)
labels: one search label set per arm

pilot.nesting_note: P1's 94 rows are a subset of P3's 926 by construction, matching the frontier's nested design; P_depth is causal for depth at fixed rows, P_rows is causal for adding rows at fixed depth

contrasts.P_depth: test_loss(P2) - test_loss(P1) — causal for depth at fixed rows
contrasts.P_rows: test_loss(P3) - test_loss(P2) — causal for adding rows at fixed depth
contrasts.P_econ: test_loss(P3) - test_loss(P1) — NOT matched-compute; 2.8x cheaper teacher bill, 9.9x more rows

pilot.reading_rule: all contrasts at all widths reported with CIs; P_econ CI upper < 0 at every width => broad-shallow beats narrow-deep at 40% of the compute; CI containing 0 => no detectable difference at 40% of the compute; CI lower > 0 at every width => depth is load-bearing
non_claims: P3 is the entire train-eligible pool, not a sample
pilot results never enter the frontier decision rule
